classes.heading: Learn to Bake Challah!
paragraphs: Join us for a fun and informative Challah Baking Class on the Vineyard. Learn the fundamentals of dough preparation, master beautiful braiding techniques, and take home the skills (and recipes) to bake fresh, bakery-quality challah whenever you crave it.
Private individual and small group classes available in Chilmark and island-wide.

catering.heading: Something extra for your event
paragraphs: Looking for something extra for a private event? We have a wide variety of offerings, including custom cheeseboards, grazing tables, catered dinners, and more. Please reach out for more information.
